finalMessage:
I linked `deploy/database.tf` to C-DB-ENCRYPTION, but no test covers it. The repo has no test that runs against `deploy/`. The only item that verifies the control is the manual review V-INFRA-REVIEW.

**The change:** I added one line to the C-DB-ENCRYPTION item in `trace/threats.yaml`:

```yaml
    controls: [THREAT-DB-SNAPSHOT]
    code: [deploy/database.tf]
```

I did not commit it. The `code:` field is used on requirement and design items, but not on controls. I could not check the change with the ostf validator because it is not installed here, so the spec may not accept `code:` on a control.

**Tests covering the file:** none. `README.md` says `deploy/` is "Terraform for the database and the load balancer, which no test runs." I did not add a `tests:` field, because there is no test to point it at. `npm test` passes all 36 tests, but none of them exercise `deploy/`.

**What the file does for the control:** by reading, `deploy/database.tf` sets `storage_encrypted = true` with a customer-managed KMS key that has `enable_key_rotation = true` and a 365-day period. That matches the control text. I did not run `terraform validate` or `plan`, because Terraform is not installed here. RDS snapshots of an encrypted instance are encrypted too, but I did not check that against the provider.

**Items for the pull request reviewer:**
- **C-DB-ENCRYPTION** (touched): your link is new, and the item text is unchanged. It controls THREAT-DB-SNAPSHOT, so it needs review.
- **V-INFRA-REVIEW** (not touched): it verifies C-DB-ENCRYPTION and C-TLS-ONLY through a manual review of `deploy/`. It is the only check on this file.
- **THREAT-DB-SNAPSHOT** (not touched): this is the threat the control addresses.

If you want an automated check, a `terraform validate` or plan-based test would be new behavior. Per AGENTS.md, it would need a new item with `status: draft`, linked to its code and tests in the same change. I can draft that if you want it.
